text.p: The Malaysian government will offer a scholarship to a 12-year-old mathematics whiz in Britain who has been admitted to Oxford University, Education Minister Najib Tun Razak said on Wednesday.
Sufiah Yusof, who lives in Britain, would be required to serve Malaysia on completion of her studies, Najib told reporters after the weekly Cabinet meeting.
Sufiah's father Farooq Yusof is a British citizen but her mother, Halimahton, is a Malaysian.
Sufiah's family said she intended to enrol at Oxford in October after passing her A-level examinations in mathematics with flying colours.
Najib said it was not a normal practice to offer such scholarships but Sufiah, who is also a junior tennis star in Britain, was special.
